headline: eBay (EBAY) Is Down 6.7% After Depop-Driven Cost Concerns and Analyst Downgrades Ahead of Q2 Earnings
summary: In recent days, eBay has faced multiple analyst downgrades ahead of its August 5 second-quarter 2026 earnings release, with concerns centered on rising competitive pressure in U.S. recommerce and higher marketing costs tied to the newly closed US$1.40 billion Depop acquisition. At the same time, eBay is pushing ahead with product and marketplace changes, from AI-enabled tools and eBay Live monetization to Australia’s new Extended Bidding auction format, highlighting management’s focus on...
